facts.raw_span: 2 months of progressive right earache and headache without fever
without fever
2 weeks of mild left-sided weakness
1 week of intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech
left pronator drift
no obvious manifestation of external ear canal infection during endoscopy of the right ear
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate: 42 mm/h (normal, <20 mm/h)
C-reactive protein level: 25 mg/L (normal, <10 mg/L)
Glycosylated hemoglobin A1C level: 6.8% (normal, 4.3%-6.1%)
positive for anti-NMDAR antibodies (CSF titer 1:320, serum titer 1:100)
CT scan of temporal bone showed otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear
Coronal FLAIR image demonstrated extensive area of hyperintensity with compressed right lateral ventricle

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of hallucinations, nonsensical speech, and left-sided weakness, combined with the presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies in the CSF and serum, support the diagnosis of anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
The patient's symptoms of right earache and the CT scan findings of otitis media, mastoiditis, and local bone destruction in the right ear support the diagnosis of otitis media.
The patient's symptoms of right earache and the CT scan findings of mastoiditis support the diagnosis of mastoiditis.
The patient's glycosylated hemoglobin A1C level of 6.8% supports the diagnosis of type 2 diabetes.
The patient's symptoms of headache and the presence of Candida tropicalis in the CSF support the diagnosis of Candida tropicalis meningitis.

The patient's symptoms of hallucinations, nonsensical speech, and left-sided weakness, combined with the presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies in the CSF and serum, support the diagnosis of autoimmune encephalitis.
The patient's symptoms of headache and the elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level support the diagnosis of inflammatory meningitis.
The patient's medical history includes hypertension.

rationales.F01: Right earache and headache could be related to otitis media or mastoiditis.
rationales.F04: Hallucinations and nonsensical speech are characteristic of anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
rationales.F10: Presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies is diagnostic of anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
rationales.F11: CT scan findings are consistent with otitis media and mastoiditis.
